comments.author: Theo
comments.body: So how much is it worth?

comments.author: Meng Meng
comments.body: It's only redeeming factor is that it's rare. If you want an aide trading ship that can defend itself you will need to max sailors (refit max not mod) on this ship, compare that to minimum crew MFCV that can go up to 900+ cargo you see that cargo is comparable but MFCV is a lot more robust and shoot harder and also more flexible (can refit back to 202 crew if needed).

comments.author: Laurencio
comments.body: Is 90 crew enough to use 4x16 cannons? I wanna buy this!

comments.author: Meng Meng
comments.body: needs 97 sailor for 16x4... you can see that in this page

comments.body:
Hmmm so when this ship is out on Tbox again it should be relatively cheap I hope.

Btw where do I see it on this page I looked real hard still couldnt find it.

comments.author: Francine
comments.body: Oh shit I found it now... so what is the percentage 75% 76%....125% seems like cargo percentage so is the number blow it turn speed? I never knew reducing cargo increases turn?

comments.author: Nina
comments.body: yes, reducing cargo can add turn, but in some ships, the extra turn comes in penalty area. If that turn comes at 79% cargo, ship get +1 turn but WR and sail penalty. But, that penalties can be overcome with improvements. BTW.... indiaman with min cargo is still worse than RF at battle

comments.author: Nina
comments.body:
RF = Royal Frigate?
So... Festive Indiaman worse than Mod Frigate in battle? But Festive Indiaman has more dura/armor and IMO better ship skills?

comments.author: Nicola
comments.body: what i notice in changing cargo is, the higher the base cargo the more -% you need to do to add more turns, which means more penalty.

comments.author: Sonia
comments.body: funny when people compare trading ships and battle ones,I think ambush first class barca is the best ship for you if it has more turn,more dura,more armour...only 1 broadside-who cares?)

comments.author: Maria
comments.body: agree with that Sonia

comments.author: Maria
comments.body: indiaman just 4 slot broadside though

comments.author: Rashid
comments.body: Wow... your stupidity amazes me... maybe he/she wanted a trading ship that can somewhat defend against pirates? When they're in a fleet having a member or two who can escort the whole fleet isn't such a bad idea right? Who knows maybe he/she wants an escort ship that can carry some cargo and not just tag along for nothing? That member can sail between members and pirate to block cannon shots and can use heavy bombing to stop the pirate from boarding?

comments.author: Rashid
comments.body: Sonia stop throwing out of context stupid comments.

comments.body: I don't care if it's not a pvp ship. My girlfriend thinks indiamans are cute and f.ind is better than m.ind so i wanna buy one.

comments.body: Liza that's about the best reason I've seen anyone wanting to buy a ship for. You might let your girl know that by all rights The Black Pearl should be an Indiaman. Just in case she's a fan of the show or movies.

comments.body: If you don't care whether it's PvP ship why bother with festive Indiaman and not just modified Indiaman you dumb?

comments.author: Meng Meng
comments.body: Festive Indiaman has larger cargo and higher armor/dura helps against npc pirates not everyone spam tributes.

comments.body: If you aren't a fan and just want to get an armed merchant ship MMG is only 1-1.2b similar cargo has improved hold which takes 3 permits to add as original skill thus valuable plus MMG can refit to 114 sailors 10 more than minimum for x16 cannons!
